description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'ActivationDirectory' which manages a thread-safe collection of grain activation contexts within Orleans runtime. It provides methods for adding, removing, and locating activations, and includes disposal logic for cleanup.

classes.name: ActivationDirectory
classes.description: Manages grain activation contexts, providing thread-safe operations for registration, removal, enumeration, and asynchronous disposal.

methods.name: FindTarget
methods.description: Locates a grain activation context by its GrainId.

methods.name: RecordNewTarget
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation context.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over stored grain activation contexts.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes all grain activation contexts, awaiting their disposal if applicable.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes all grain activation contexts.
